overview: MetaZoo Wilderness (Pinclub) is a small five-token ERC-1155 set (IDs 7 to 11) sharing its contract with the Valentines drop.

It accompanied the Wilderness set, released 14 March 2022, and the $150 Pin Club case that Coin Token holders could buy: each case came with an exclusive promo card and a Wilderness NFT airdropped per purchase. MetaZoo put the NFT-label Wilderness box run at around 2,800 to 3,000, and capped the token-holder presale at two boxes per Coin Token.
On-chain activity is minimal: the Wilderness tokens trade rarely and for small amounts, and combined Valentines plus Wilderness volume is roughly 0.4 ETH (a few hundred dollars).

off_chain_basis.note: The Wilderness Pin Club drop carried an off-chain mint price around $150, far above the negligible on-chain fee. Against the current floor, that $150 cost basis leaves holders deeply underwater on what they actually paid.
